canonical_name: No Learning from Information Security Incidents
description: Knowledge from security incidents is not used to strengthen controls and reduce future incidents.
applicability: Applies when an organization fails to analyze lessons learned from information security incidents, does not implement corrective actions based on incident findings, or does not use incident knowledge to improve security controls and prevent recurrence.

metadata.detection_notes: Review post-incident review procedures, verify existence of lessons learned documentation, check for implementation of corrective actions, assess incident trend analysis processes, examine security control improvement initiatives based on incidents.
